title.why: original_title matches the GU heading apart from layout: 'LEGGE' in capitals in the source, the en dash added by the register, and the source's closing full stop and code (25G00143). 'Provisions and delegations to the Government on artificial intelligence' is a literal rendering.

summary_claims.claim: It names AgID and the National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) as national AI authorities
requires parental consent for children under 14 to use AI
It creates a criminal offence for unlawfully spreading AI-generated or altered content (deepfakes) and delegates the Government to adopt decrees aligning Italian law with the AI Act.
